Name: [Project] SLA % measures must apply the SLA Scale what-if
Description: team-kpi: every '... SLA %' measure must read [SLA Scale %] (directly or through [Resolution SLA %]); otherwise the SLA Scale slider silently stops moving that number and the what-if page lies.
Expression: Name.EndsWith("SLA %") and not (Expression.Contains("[SLA Scale %]") or Expression.Contains("[Resolution SLA %]"))
